v.t: Ta, Ha
v.l: Taha

v.t: We did not reveal the Quran to you to make you suffer
v.l: Ma 'Anzalna `Alayka Al-Qur'ana Litashqa

v.t: But only as a reminder for him who fears
v.l: Illa Tadhkiratan Liman Yakhsha

v.t: A revelation from He who created the earth and the high heavens
v.l: Tanzilaan Mimman Khalaqa Al-'Arđa Wa As-Samawati Al-`Ula

v.t: The Most Merciful; on the Throne He settled
v.l: Ar-Rahmanu `Ala Al-`Arshi Astawa

v.t: To Him belongs everything in the heavens and the earth, and everything between them, and everything beneath the soil
v.l: Lahu Ma Fi As-Samawati Wa Ma Fi Al-'Arđi Wa Ma Baynahuma Wa Ma Tahta Ath-Thara

v.t: If you speak aloud—He knows the secret, and the most hidden
v.l: Wa 'In Tajhar Bil-Qawli Fa'innahu Ya`lamu As-Sirra Wa 'Akhfa

v.t: God, there is no god but He, His are the Most Beautiful Names
v.l: Allahu La 'Ilaha 'Illa Huwa Lahu Al-'Asma'u Al-Husna

v.t: Has the story of Moses reached you
v.l: Wa Hal 'Ataka Hadithu Musa

v.t: When he saw a fire, he said to his family, “Stay; I have noticed a fire; Perhaps I can bring you a torch therefrom, or find some guidance by the fire.”
v.l: Idh Ra'a Naraan Faqala Li'hlihi Amkuthu 'Inni 'Anastu Naraan La`alli 'Atikum Minha Biqabasin 'Aw 'Ajidu `Ala An-Nari Hudaan

v.t: Then, when he reached it, he was called, “O Moses
v.l: Falamma 'Ataha Nudi Ya Musa

v.t: I—I am your Lord. Take off your shoes. You are in the sacred valley of Tuwa
v.l: Inni 'Ana Rabbuka Fakhla` Na`layka 'Innaka Bil-Wadi Al-Muqaddasi Tuaan

v.t: I have chosen you, so listen to what is revealed
v.l: Wa 'Ana Akhtartuka Fastami` Lima Yuha

v.t: I—I am God. There is no God but I. So serve Me, and practice the prayer for My remembrance
v.l: Innani 'Ana Allahu La 'Ilaha 'Illa 'Ana Fa`budni Wa 'Aqimi As-Salaata Lidhikri

v.t: The Hour is coming—but I keep it almost hidden—so that each soul will be paid for what it endeavors
v.l: Inna As-Sa`ata 'Atiyatun 'Akadu 'Ukhfiha Litujza Kullu Nafsin Bima Tas`a

v.t: And do not let him who denies it and follows his desire turn you away from it, lest you fall
v.l: Fala Yasuddannaka `Anha Man La Yu'uminu Biha Wa Attaba`a Hawahu Fatarda

v.t: And what is that in your right-hand, O Moses?”
v.l: Wa Ma Tilka Biyaminika Ya Musa

v.t: He said, “This is my staff. I lean on it, and herd my sheep with it, and I have other uses for it.”
v.l: Qala Hiya `Asaya 'Atawakka'u `Alayha Wa 'Ahushu Biha `Ala Ghanami Wa Liya Fiha Ma'aribu 'Ukhra

v.t: He said, “Throw it, O Moses.”
v.l: Qala 'Alqiha Ya Musa

v.t: So he threw it—thereupon it became a moving serpent
v.l: Fa'alqaha Fa'idha Hiya Hayyatun Tas`a

v.t: He said, “Take hold of it, and do not fear. We will restore it to its original condition
v.l: Qala Khudh/ha Wa La Takhaf Sanu`iduha Sirataha Al-'Ula

v.t: And press your hand to your side; it will come out white, without a blemish—another sign
v.l: Wa Ađmum Yadaka 'Ila Janahika Takhruj Bayđa'a Min Ghayri Su'in 'Ayatan 'Ukhra

v.t: That We may show you some of Our greatest signs
v.l: Linuriyaka Min 'Ayatina Al-Kubra

v.t: Go to Pharaoh; He has transgressed.”
v.l: Adh/hab 'Ila Fir`awna 'Innahu Tagha

v.t: He said, “My Lord, put my heart at peace for me
v.l: Qala Rabbi Ashrah Li Sadri

v.t: And ease my task for me
v.l: Wa Yassir Li 'Amri

v.t: And untie the knot from my tongue
v.l: Wa Ahlul `Uqdatan Min Lisani

v.t: So they can understand my speech
v.l: Yafqahu Qawli

v.t: And appoint an assistant for me, from my family
v.l: Wa Aj`al Li Waziraan Min 'Ahli

v.t: Aaron, my brother
v.l: Haruna 'Akhi

v.t: Strengthen me with him
v.l: Ashdud Bihi 'Azri

v.t: And have him share in my mission
v.l: Wa 'Ashrik/hu Fi 'Amri

v.t: That we may glorify You much
v.l: Kay Nusabbihaka Kathiraan

v.t: And remember You much
v.l: Wa Nadhkuraka Kathiraan

v.t: You are always watching over us.”
v.l: Innaka Kunta Bina Basiraan

v.t: He said, “You are granted your request, O Moses
v.l: Qala Qad 'Utita Su'ulaka Ya Musa

v.t: We had favored you another time
v.l: Wa Laqad Mananna `Alayka Marratan 'Ukhra

v.t: When We inspired your mother with the inspiration
v.l: Idh 'Awhayna 'Ila 'Ummika Ma Yuha

v.t: Put him in the chest; then cast him into the river. The river will wash him to shore, where an enemy of Mine and an enemy of his will pick him up. And I have bestowed upon you love from Me, so that you may be reared before My eye
v.l: Ani Aqdhifihi Fi At-Tabuti Faqdhifihi Fi Al-Yammi Falyulqihi Al-Yammu Bis-Sahili Ya'khudh/hu `Aduwun Li Wa`aduwun Lahu Wa 'Alqaytu `Alayka Mahabbatan Minni Wa Litusna`a `Ala `Ayni
w: and that you may be brought up

v.t: When your sister walked along, and said, ‘Shall I tell you about someone who will take care of him?' So We returned you to your mother, that she may be comforted, and not sorrow. And you killed a person, but We saved you from stress; and We tested you thoroughly. And you stayed years among the people of Median. Then you came back, as ordained, O Moses
v.l: Idh Tamshi 'Ukhtuka Fataqulu Hal 'Adullukum `Ala Man Yakfuluhu Faraja`naka 'Ila 'Ummika Kay Taqarra `Aynuha Wa La Tahzana Wa Qatalta Nafsaan Fanajjaynaka Mina Al-Ghammi Wa Fatannaka Futunaan Falabithta Sinina Fi 'Ahli Madyana Thumma Ji'ta `Ala Qadarin Ya Musa

v.t: And I made you for Myself
v.l: Wa Astana`tuka Linafsi

v.t: Go, you and your brother, with My signs, and do not neglect My remembrance
v.l: Adh/hab 'Anta Wa 'Akhuka Bi'ayati Wa La Taniya Fi Dhikri

v.t: Go to Pharaoh. He has tyrannized
v.l: Adh/haba 'Ila Fir`awna 'Innahu Tagha

v.t: But speak to him nicely. Perhaps he will remember, or have some fear.”
v.l: Faqula Lahu Qawlaan Layyinaan La`allahu Yatadhakkaru 'Aw Yakhsha

v.t: They said, “Lord, we fear he may persecute us, or become violent.”
v.l: Qala Rabbana 'Innana Nakhafu 'An Yafruta `Alayna 'Aw 'An Yatgha

v.t: He said, “Do not fear, I am with you, I hear and I see
v.l: Qala La Takhafa 'Innani Ma`akuma 'Asma`u Wa 'Ara

v.t: Approach him and say, `We are the messengers of your Lord; so let the Children of Israel go with us, and do not torment them. We bring you a sign from your Lord, and peace be upon him who follows guidance
v.l: Fa'tiyahu Faqula 'Inna Rasula Rabbika Fa'arsil Ma`ana Bani 'Isra'ila Wa La Tu`adhibhum Qad Ji'naka Bi'ayatin Min Rabbika Wa As-Salamu `Ala Mani Attaba`a Al-Huda

v.t: It was revealed to us that the punishment falls upon him who disbelieves and turns away.'“
v.l: Inna Qad 'Uhiya 'Ilayna 'Anna Al-`Adhaba `Ala Man Kadhaba Wa Tawalla

v.t: He said, “Who is your Lord, O Moses.”
v.l: Qala Faman Rabbukuma Ya Musa

v.t: He said, “Our Lord is He who gave everything its existence, then guided it.”
v.l: Qala Rabbuna Al-Ladhi 'A`ta Kulla Shay'in Khalqahu Thumma Hada

v.t: He said, “What about the first generations?”
v.l: Qala Fama Balu Al-Quruni Al-'Ula

v.t: He said, “Knowledge thereof is with my Lord, in a Book. My Lord never errs, nor does He forget.”
v.l: Qala `Ilmuha `Inda Rabbi Fi Kitabin La Yađillu Rabbi Wa La Yansa

v.t: He who made the earth a habitat for you; and traced in it routes for you; and sent down water from the sky, with which We produce pairs of diverse plants
v.l: Al-Ladhi Ja`ala Lakumu Al-'Arđa Mahdaan Wa Salaka Lakum Fiha Subulaan Wa 'Anzala Mina As-Sama'i Ma'an Fa'akhrajna Bihi 'Azwajaan Min Nabatin Shatta

v.t: Eat and pasture your livestock. In that are signs for those with understanding
v.l: Kulu Wa Ar`aw 'An`amakum 'Inna Fi Dhalika La'ayatin Li'wli An-Nuha

v.t: From it We created you, and into it We will return you, and from it We will bring you out another time
v.l: Minha Khalaqnakum Wa Fiha Nu`idukum Wa Minha Nukhrijukum Taratan 'Ukhra

v.t: We showed him Our signs, all of them, but he denied and refused
v.l: Wa Laqad 'Araynahu 'Ayatina Kullaha Fakadhaba Wa 'Aba

v.t: He said, “Did you come to us to drive us out of our land with your magic, O Moses
v.l: Qala 'Aji'tana Litukhrijana Min 'Arđina Bisihrika Ya Musa

v.t: We will produce for you magic like it; so make an appointment between us and you, which we will not miss—neither us, nor you—in a central place.”
v.l: Falana'tiyannaka Bisihrin Mithlihi Faj`al Baynana Wa Baynaka Maw`idaan La Nukhlifuhu Nahnu Wa La 'Anta Makanaan Suaan
w: Then we will surely produce for you

v.t: He said, “Your appointment is the day of the festival, so let the people be gathered together at mid-morning.”
v.l: Qala Maw`idukum Yawmu Az-Zinati Wa 'An Yuhshara An-Nasu Đuhaan

v.t: Pharaoh turned away, put together his plan, and then came back
v.l: Fatawalla Fir`awnu Fajama`a Kaydahu Thumma 'Ata

v.t: Moses said to them, “Woe to you. Do not fabricate lies against God, or He will destroy you with a punishment. He who invents lies will fail.”
v.l: Qala Lahum Musa Waylakum La Taftaru `Ala Allahi Kadhibaan Fayushitakum Bi`adhabin Wa Qad Khaba Mani Aftara

v.t: They disagreed among themselves over their affair, and conferred secretly
v.l: Fatanaza`u 'Amrahum Baynahum Wa 'Asarru An-Najwa

v.t: They said, “These two are magicians who want to drive you out of your land with their magic, and to abolish your exemplary way of life
v.l: Qalu 'In Hadhani Lasahirani Yuridani 'An Yukhrijakum Min 'Arđikum Bisihrihima Wa Yadh/haba Bitariqatikumu Al-Muthla

v.t: So settle your plan, and come as one front. Today, whoever gains the upper hand will succeed.”
v.l: Fa'ajmi`u Kaydakum Thumma A'tu Saffaan Wa Qad 'Aflaha Al-Yawma Mani Asta`la

v.t: They said, “O Moses, either you throw, or we will be the first to throw.”
v.l: Qalu Ya Musa 'Imma 'An Tulqiya Wa 'Imma 'An Nakuna 'Awwala Man 'Alqa

v.t: He said, “You throw.” And suddenly, their ropes and sticks appeared to him, because of their magic, to be crawling swiftly
v.l: Qala Bal 'Alqu Fa'idha Hibaluhum Wa `Isiyuhum Yukhayyalu 'Ilayhi Min Sihrihim 'Annaha Tas`a

v.t: So Moses felt apprehensive within himself
v.l: Fa'awjasa Fi Nafsihi Khifatan Musa

v.t: We said, “Do not be afraid, you are the uppermost
v.l: Qulna La Takhaf 'Innaka 'Anta Al-'A`la

v.t: Now throw down what is in your right hand—it will swallow what they have crafted. What they have crafted is only a magician’s trickery. But the magician will not succeed, no matter what he does.”
v.l: Wa 'Alqi Ma Fi Yaminika Talqaf Ma Sana`u 'Innama Sana`u Kaydu Sahirin Wa La Yuflihu As-Sahiru Haythu 'Ata

v.t: And the magicians fell down prostrate. They said, “We have believed in the Lord of Aaron and Moses.”
v.l: Fa'ulqiya As-Saharatu Sujjadaan Qalu 'Amanna Birabbi Haruna Wa Musa

v.t: He said, “Did you believe in him before I have given you permission? He must be your chief, who has taught you magic. I will cut off your hands and your feet on alternate sides, and I will crucify you on the trunks of the palm-trees. Then you will know which of us is more severe in punishment, and more lasting.”
v.l: Qala 'Amantum Lahu Qabla 'An 'Adhana Lakum 'Innahu Lakabirukumu Al-Ladhi `Allamakumu As-Sihra Fala'uqatti`anna 'Aydiyakum Wa 'Arjulakum Min Khilafin Wa La'usallibannakum Fi Judhu`i An-Nakhli Wa Lata`lamunna 'Ayyuna 'Ashaddu `Adhabaan Wa 'Abqa
w: So surely I will cut off
and surely I will crucify you

v.t: They said, “We will not prefer you to the proofs that have come to us, and Him who created us. So issue whatever judgment you wish to issue. You can only rule in this lowly life
v.l: Qalu Lan Nu'uthiraka `Ala Ma Ja'ana Mina Al-Bayyinati Wa Al-Ladhi Fatarana Faqđi Ma 'Anta Qađin 'Innama Taqđi Hadhihi Al-Hayaata Ad-Dunya

v.t: We have believed in our Lord, so that He may forgive us our sins, and the magic you have compelled us to practice. God is Better, and more Lasting.”
v.l: Inna 'Amanna Birabbina Liyaghfira Lana Khatayana Wa Ma 'Akrahtana `Alayhi Mina As-Sihri Wa Allahu Khayrun Wa 'Abqa

v.t: Whoever comes to his Lord guilty, for him is Hell, where he neither dies nor lives
v.l: Innahu Man Ya'ti Rabbahu Mujrimaan Fa'inna Lahu Jahannama La Yamutu Fiha Wa La Yahya

v.t: But whoever comes to Him a believer, having worked righteousness—these will have the highest ranks
v.l: Wa Man Ya'tihi Mu'uminaan Qad `Amila As-Salihati Fa'ula'ika Lahumu Ad-Darajatu Al-`Ula

v.t: The Gardens of Perpetuity, beneath which rivers flow, dwelling therein forever. That is the reward for him who purifies himself
v.l: Jannatu `Adnin Tajri Min Tahtiha Al-'Anharu Khalidina Fiha Wa Dhalika Jaza'u Man Tazakka

v.t: And We inspired Moses: “Travel by night with My servants, and strike for them a dry path across the sea, not fearing being overtaken, nor worrying.”
v.l: Wa Laqad 'Awhayna 'Ila Musa 'An 'Asri Bi`ibadi Fađrib Lahum Tariqaan Fi Al-Bahri Yabasaan La Takhafu Darakaan Wa La Takhsha

v.t: Pharaoh pursued them with his troops, but the sea overwhelmed them, and completely engulfed them
v.l: Fa'atba`ahum Fir`awnu Bijunudihi Faghashiyahum Mina Al-Yammi Ma Ghashiyahum

v.t: Pharaoh misled his people, and did not guide them
v.l: Wa 'Ađalla Fir`awnu Qawmahu Wa Ma Hada

v.t: O Children of Israel! We have delivered you from your enemy, and promised you by the right side of the Mount, and sent down to you manna and quails
v.l: Ya Bani 'Isra'ila Qad 'Anjaynakum Min `Aduwikum Wa Wa`adnakum Janiba At-Turi Al-'Aymana Wa Nazzalna `Alaykumu Al-Manna Wa As-Salwa
w: and We made a covenant with you

v.t: Eat of the good things We have provided for you, but do not be excessive therein, lest My wrath descends upon you. He upon whom My wrath descends has fallen
v.l: Kulu Min Tayyibati Ma Razaqnakum Wa La Tatghaw Fihi Fayahilla `Alaykum Ghađabi Wa Man Yahlil `Alayhi Ghađabi Faqad Hawa

v.t: And I am Forgiving towards him who repents, believes, acts righteously, and then remains guided
v.l: Wa 'Inni Laghaffarun Liman Taba Wa 'Amana Wa `Amila Salihaan Thumma Ahtada

v.t: “And what made you rush ahead of your people, O Moses?”
v.l: Wa Ma 'A`jalaka `An Qawmika Ya Musa

v.t: He said, “They are following in my footsteps; and I hurried on to You, my Lord, that you may be pleased.”
v.l: Qala Hum 'Ula'i `Ala 'Athari Wa `Ajiltu 'Ilayka Rabbi Litarđa

v.t: He said, “We have tested your people in your absence, and the Samarian misled them.”
v.l: Qala Fa'inna Qad Fatanna Qawmaka Min Ba`dika Wa 'Ađallahumu As-Samiriyu

v.t: So Moses returned to his people, angry and disappointed. He said, “O my people, did your Lord not promise you a good promise? Was the time too long for you? Or did you want wrath from your Lord to descend upon you, so you broke your promise to me?”
v.l: Faraja`a Musa 'Ila Qawmihi Ghađbana 'Asifaan Qala Ya Qawmi 'Alam Ya`idkum Rabbukum Wa`daan Hasanaan 'Afatala `Alaykumu Al-`Ahdu 'Am 'Aradtum 'An Yahilla `Alaykum Ghađabun Min Rabbikum Fa'akhlaftum Maw`idi

v.t: They said, “We did not break our promise to you by our choice, but we were made to carry loads of the people’s ornaments, and we cast them in. That was what the Samarian suggested.”
v.l: Qalu Ma 'Akhlafna Maw`idaka Bimalkina Wa Lakinna Hummilna 'Awzaraan Min Zinati Al-Qawmi Faqadhafnaha Fakadhalika 'Alqa As-Samiriyu

v.t: So he produced for them a calf—a mere body which lowed. And they said, “This is your god, and the god of Moses, but he has forgotten.”
v.l: Fa'akhraja Lahum `Ijlaan Jasadaan Lahu Khuwarun Faqalu Hadha 'Ilahukum Wa 'Ilahu Musa Fanasiya

v.t: Did they not see that it cannot return a word to them, and has no power to harm them or benefit them
v.l: Afala Yarawna 'Alla Yarji`u 'Ilayhim Qawlaan Wa La Yamliku Lahum Đarraan Wa La Naf`aan

v.t: Aaron had said to them before, “O my people, you are being tested by this. And your Lord is the Merciful, so follow me, and obey my command.”
v.l: Wa Laqad Qala Lahum Harunu Min Qablu Ya Qawmi 'Innama Futintum Bihi Wa 'Inna Rabbakumu Ar-Rahmanu Fa Attabi`uni Wa 'Ati`u 'Amri

v.t: They said, “We will not give up our devotion to it, until Moses returns to us.”
v.l: Qalu Lan Nabraha `Alayhi `Akifina Hatta Yarji`a 'Ilayna Musa

v.t: He said, “O Aaron, what prevented you, when you saw them going astray
v.l: Qala Ya Harunu Ma Mana`aka 'Idh Ra'aytahum Đallu

v.t: From following me? Did you disobey my command?”
v.l: Alla Tattabi`ani 'Afa`asayta 'Amri

v.t: He said, “Son of my mother, do not seize me by my beard or my head. I feared you would say, `You have caused division among the Children of Israel, and did not regard my word.'“
v.l: Qala Yabna'uumma La Ta'khudh Bilihyati Wa La Bira'si 'Inni Khashitu 'An Taqula Farraqta Bayna Bani 'Isra'ila Wa Lam Tarqub Qawli

v.t: He said, “What do you have to say, O Samarian?”
v.l: Qala Fama Khatbuka Ya Samiriyu

v.t: He said, “I saw what they did not see, so I grasped a handful from the Messenger’s traces, and I flung it away. Thus my soul prompted me.”
v.l: Qala Basurtu Bima Lam Yabsuru Bihi Faqabađtu Qabđatan Min 'Athari Ar-Rasuli Fanabadhtuha Wa Kadhalika Sawwalat Li Nafsi

v.t: He said, “Begone! Your lot in this life is to say, ‘No contact.’ And you have an appointment that you will not miss. Now look at your god that you remained devoted to—we will burn it up, and then blow it away into the sea, as powder.”
v.l: Qala Fadh/hab Fa'inna Laka Fi Al-Hayaati 'An Taqula La Misasa Wa 'Inna Laka Maw`idaan Lan Tukhlafahu Wa Anzur 'Ila 'Ilahika Al-Ladhi Zalta `Alayhi `Akifaan Lanuharriqannahu Thumma Lanansifannahu Fi Al-Yammi Nasfaan

v.t: Surely your god is God, the One besides whom there is no other god. He comprehends everything in knowledge
v.l: Innama 'Ilahukumu Allahu Al-Ladhi La 'Ilaha 'Illa Huwa Wasi`a Kulla Shay'in `Ilmaan

v.t: Thus We narrate to you reports of times gone by; and We have given you a message from Our Presence
v.l: Kadhalika Naqussu `Alayka Min 'Anba'i Ma Qad Sabaqa Wa Qad 'Ataynaka Min Ladunna Dhikraan

v.t: Whoever turns away from it will carry on the Day of Resurrection a burden
v.l: Man 'A`rađa `Anhu Fa'innahu Yahmilu Yawma Al-Qiyamati Wizraan

v.t: Abiding therein forever. And wretched is their burden on the Day of Resurrection
v.l: Khalidina Fihi Wa Sa'a Lahum Yawma Al-Qiyamati Himlaan

v.t: On the Day when the Trumpet is blown—We will gather the sinners on that Day, blue
v.l: Yawma Yunfakhu Fi As-Suri Wa Nahshuru Al-Mujrimina Yawma'idhin Zurqaan

v.t: Murmuring among themselves: “You have lingered only for ten.”
v.l: Yatakhafatuna Baynahum 'In Labithtum 'Illa `Ashraan

v.t: We are fully aware of what they say, when the most exemplary of them in conduct will say, “You have lingered only a day.”
v.l: Nahnu 'A`lamu Bima Yaquluna 'Idh Yaqulu 'Amthaluhum Tariqatan 'In Labithtum 'Illa Yawmaan

v.t: And they ask you about the mountains. Say, “My Lord will crumble them utterly.”
v.l: Wa Yas'alunaka `Ani Al-Jibali Faqul Yansifuha Rabbi Nasfaan

v.t: And leave them desolate waste
v.l: Fayadharuha Qa`aan Safsafaan

v.t: You will see in them neither crookedness, nor deviation.”
v.l: La Tara Fiha `Iwajaan Wa La 'Amtaan

v.t: On that Day, they will follow the caller, without any deviation. Voices will be hushed before the Merciful, and you will hear nothing but murmur
v.l: Yawma'idhin Yattabi`una Ad-Da`i La `Iwaja Lahu Wa Khasha`ati Al-'Aswatu Lilrrahmani Fala Tasma`u 'Illa Hamsaan

v.t: On that Day, intercession will not avail, except for him permitted by the Merciful, and whose words He has approved
v.l: Yawma'idhin La Tanfa`u Ash-Shafa`atu 'Illa Man 'Adhina Lahu Ar-Rahmanu Wa Rađiya Lahu Qawlaan

v.t: He knows what is before them and what is behind them, and they cannot comprehend Him in their knowledge
v.l: Ya`lamu Ma Bayna 'Aydihim Wa Ma Khalfahum Wa La Yuhituna Bihi `Ilmaan

v.t: Faces will be humbled before the Living, the Eternal. Whoever carries injustice will despair
v.l: Wa `Anati Al-Wujuhu Lilhayyi Al-Qayyumi Wa Qad Khaba Man Hamala Zulmaan

v.t: But whoever has done righteous deeds, while being a believer—will fear neither injustice, nor grievance
v.l: Wa Man Ya`mal Mina As-Salihati Wa Huwa Mu'uminun Fala Yakhafu Zulmaan Wa La Hađmaan

v.t: Thus We have revealed it an Arabic Quran, and We have diversified the warnings in it, that perhaps they would become righteous, or it may produce a lesson for them
v.l: Wa Kadhalika 'Anzalnahu Qur'anaan `Arabiyaan Wa Sarrafna Fihi Mina Al-Wa`idi La`allahum Yattaquna 'Aw Yuhdithu Lahum Dhikraan

v.t: Exalted is God, the True King. Do not be hasty with the Quran before its inspiration to you is concluded, and say, “My Lord, increase me in knowledge.”
v.l: Fata`ala Allahu Al-Maliku Al-Haqqu Wa La Ta`jal Bil-Qur'ani Min Qabli 'An Yuqđa 'Ilayka Wahyuhu Wa Qul Rabbi Zidni `Ilmaan

v.t: And We covenanted with Adam before, but he forgot, and We found in him no resolve
v.l: Wa Laqad `Ahidna 'Ila 'Adama Min Qablu Fanasiya Wa Lam Najid Lahu `Azmaan

v.t: And when We said to the angels, “Bow down to Adam.” They bowed down, except for Satan; he refused
v.l: Wa 'Idh Qulna Lilmala'ikati Asjudu Li'dama Fasajadu 'Illa 'Iblisa 'Aba

v.t: We said, “O Adam, this is an enemy to you and to your wife. So do not let him make you leave the Garden, for then you will suffer
v.l: Faqulna Ya 'Adamu 'Inna Hadha `Aduwun Laka Wa Lizawjika Fala Yukhrijannakuma Mina Al-Jannati Fatashqa

v.t: In it you will never go hungry, nor be naked
v.l: Inna Laka 'Alla Taju`a Fiha Wa La Ta`ra

v.t: Nor will you be thirsty in it, nor will you swelter.”
v.l: Wa 'Annaka La Tazma'u Fiha Wa La Tađha

v.t: But Satan whispered to him. He said, “O Adam, shall I show you the Tree of Immortality, and a kingdom that never decays?”
v.l: Fawaswasa 'Ilayhi Ash-Shaytanu Qala Ya 'Adamu Hal 'Adulluka `Ala Shajarati Al-Khuldi Wa Mulkin La Yabla

v.t: And so they ate from it; whereupon their bodies became visible to them, and they started covering themselves with the leaves of the Garden. Thus Adam disobeyed his Lord, and fell
v.l: Fa'akala Minha Fabadat Lahuma Saw'atuhuma Wa Tafiqa Yakhsifani `Alayhima Min Waraqi Al-Jannati Wa `Asa 'Adamu Rabbahu Faghawa

v.t: But then his Lord recalled him, and pardoned him, and guided him
v.l: Thumma Ajtabahu Rabbuhu Fataba `Alayhi Wa Hada

v.t: He said, “Go down from it, altogether; some of you enemies of some others. But whenever guidance comes to you from Me, whoever follows My guidance, will not go astray, nor suffer
v.l: Qala Ahbita Minha Jami`aan Ba`đukum Liba`đin `Aduwun Fa'imma Ya'tiyannakum Minni Hudaan Famani Attaba`a Hudaya Fala Yađillu Wa La Yashqa

v.t: But whoever turns away from My Reminder, for him is a confined life. And We will raise him on the Day of Resurrection blind.”
v.l: Wa Man 'A`rađa `An Dhikri Fa'inna Lahu Ma`ishatan Đankaan Wa Nahshuruhu Yawma Al-Qiyamati 'A`ma

v.t: He will say, “My Lord, why did You raise me blind, though I was seeing?”
v.l: Qala Rabbi Lima Hashartani 'A`ma Wa Qad Kuntu Basiraan

v.t: He will say, “Just as Our revelations came to you, and you forgot them, today you will be forgotten.”
v.l: Qala Kadhalika 'Atatka 'Ayatuna Fanasitaha Wa Kadhalika Al-Yawma Tunsa

v.t: Thus We recompense him who transgresses and does not believe in the revelations of his Lord. The punishment of the Hereafter is more severe, and more lasting
v.l: Wa Kadhalika Najzi Man 'Asrafa Wa Lam Yu'umin Bi'ayati Rabbihi Wa La`adhabu Al-'Akhirati 'Ashaddu Wa 'Abqa

v.t: Is it not instructive to them, how many generations before them We destroyed, in whose settlements they walk? Surely in that are signs for people of understanding
v.l: Afalam Yahdi Lahum Kam 'Ahlakna Qablahum Mina Al-Quruni Yamshuna Fi Masakinihim 'Inna Fi Dhalika La'ayatin Li'wli An-Nuha

v.t: Were it not for a word that issued from your Lord, the inevitable would have happened, but there is an appointed term
v.l: Wa Lawla Kalimatun Sabaqat Min Rabbika Lakana Lizamaan Wa 'Ajalun Musammaan

v.t: So bear patiently what they say, and celebrate the praises of your Lord before the rising of the sun, and before its setting. And during the hours of the night glorify Him, and at the borders of the day, that you may be satisfied
v.l: Fasbir `Ala Ma Yaquluna Wa Sabbih Bihamdi Rabbika Qabla Tulu`i Ash-Shamsi Wa Qabla Ghurubiha Wa Min 'Ana'i Al-Layli Fasabbih Wa 'Atrafa An-Nahari La`allaka Tarđa

v.t: And do not extend your glance towards what We have given some classes of them to enjoy—the splendor of the life of this world—that We may test them thereby. Your Lord’s provision is better, and more lasting
v.l: Wa La Tamuddanna `Aynayka 'Ila Ma Matta`na Bihi 'Azwajaan Minhum Zahrata Al-Hayaati Ad-Dunya Linaftinahum Fihi Wa Rizqu Rabbika Khayrun Wa 'Abqa

v.t: And exhort your people to pray, and patiently adhere to it. We ask of you no sustenance, but it is We who sustain you. The good ending is that for righteousness
v.l: Wa 'Mur 'Ahlaka Bis-Salaati Wa Astabir `Alayha La Nas'aluka Rizqaan Nahnu Narzuquka Wa Al-`Aqibatu Lilttaqwa

v.t: And they say, “Why does he not bring us a miracle from his Lord?” Were they not given enough miracles in the former scriptures
v.l: Wa Qalu Lawla Ya'tina Bi'ayatin Min Rabbihi 'Awalam Ta'tihim Bayyinatu Ma Fi As-Suhufi Al-'Ula

v.t: Had We destroyed them with a punishment before him, they would have said, “Our Lord, if only You had sent us a messenger, we would have followed Your revelations before we were humiliated and disgraced.”
v.l: Wa Law 'Anna 'Ahlaknahum Bi`adhabin Min Qablihi Laqalu Rabbana Lawla 'Arsalta 'Ilayna Rasulaan Fanattabi`a 'Ayatika Min Qabli 'An Nadhilla Wa Nakhza

v.t: Say, “Everybody is waiting, so wait. You will know who the people of the straight path are, and who is rightly-guided
v.l: Qul Kullun Mutarabbisun Fatarabbasu Fasata`lamuna Man 'Ashabu As-Sirati As-Sawiyi Wa Mani Ahtada
